status: Implementation in progress; full application parity remains required.

library.defaults: Unspecified controls use current committed document settings. Input must contain extension. Validate before changing state; force advanced=false after validating controls.
policy: Classify every invocation. Apply category/quality/palette recommendations.
Scan the prepared original lazily for alpha type 0/1/2; invalidate only on source replacement.
Use opaque white background only for category 1 with binary alpha; transparent white otherwise.
For palette modes 0/1, evaluate candidates 2..12, choose the completed minimum score, and pass colors through native 16-bit channel rounding. Skip palette selection for mode 2.
Run segmentation, smoothing and fitting through the canonical completed-task scheduler. Preserve session PRNG and native cache rules.
result: paletteCount: selected integer or null when palette selection was skipped
library.observer: Optional stage observer receives owned snapshots. It cannot change algorithm inputs/results through those snapshots. No observer copying when absent.
library.errors: Throw; preserve existing stage errors. Validation errors precede processing. No native executable or recorded intermediate input.

cli.input: PNG/BMP bytes detected by content. Source filename supplies canonical metadata. Stdin requires --filename; --filename is rejected for ordinary file input.
cli.output: SVG to stdout by default. Infer format from an output file suffix unless --format is explicit. --output - writes stdout. Named output leaves stdout empty. No partial vector output on conversion failure.
cli.overwrite: Existing output requires --force. Reject the same resolved input/output path. Conversion completes before file writes.
cli.help: -h/--help ignores other arguments; help vectorize is supported. Standalone --version prints package version.
cli.errors: One diagnostic on stderr, exit 1. Success exit 0. No prompts, ANSI or animations. TTY-only plain progress on stderr.
cli.componentCommands: Retain existing JSON component command behavior.

gui.button: Enable the existing Fully automatic choice. Use the shared document operation and display the fitted result.
gui.selectedSettings: Keep selected controls distinct from committed document settings. Reopening a source preserves selected scalar controls but clears palette and resets background to native retained-load values. Include unsaved frontend selected controls with the next open request.
gui.uploadApi: All POST operations use JSON. Open sends {name,bytes:base64,settings?}; there is one upload representation. Actual file limit remains 64 MiB; JSON wire limit 96 MiB. No old raw-body upload adapter.
gui.layout: Keep the established black/white shadcn layout and Lucide icons. No decorative animation.
